title: Collatz conjecture (bounded variants)
statement_short: Every orbit of $n\mapsto n/2$ or $3n+1$ reaches 1.
why_it_matters: Iconic test of whether new methods can tame simple dynamics.
known_partial_results: Tao 2019: almost all orbits attain almost bounded values.
suggested_attack: Formalize known reductions; search for structured invariants.

title: Yang–Mills mass gap (toy models)
statement_short: Existence of a quantum Yang–Mills theory on $\mathbb{R}^4$ with mass gap $\Delta>0$.
why_it_matters: Millennium problem connecting physics and analysis.
suggested_attack: Study 2D/3D lattice toy models, formalize definitions.
